settings.question: What products can I customise with Yoode?
settings.answer: You can customise T-shirts, polo shirts, sports jerseys, hoodies, sweatshirts, mugs and corporate gifts. Add your logo, artwork, names or message to create something for yourself, your team or your business. Customisation options vary by product.

settings.question: Can I order a single piece or buy in bulk?
settings.answer: Yes. We welcome single orders and bulk quantities for teams, businesses and events. Bulk pricing depends on the product, quantity and customisation you choose. Share your requirements with our team for a quote that matches your order.

settings.question: How do I place a custom order?
settings.answer: Choose your product, sizes, colours and quantity, then share your design or requirements through WhatsApp. Our team will help you confirm the details, review pricing and approve your design before production begins.

settings.question: Can you help if I don’t have a design ready?
settings.answer: Yes. Share your idea, logo or reference image, and our team will help prepare your design and suggest suitable printing or embroidery options. You’ll receive a preview to check the layout and details before approving it for production.

settings.question: How long will my order take to arrive?
settings.answer: We deliver across India. Production and delivery times depend on your products, quantity, customisation and location. Our team will share an estimated timeline before production begins. Ordering for an event? Let us know your required date when you enquire.

settings.question: How can I contact Yoode or visit a store?
settings.answer: Chat with us on WhatsApp, call +91 8069 750 293 or email info@yoode.com. You can also visit a Yoode Experience Centre to discuss your ideas in person. Find your nearest centre and directions on our store locations page.
